title: New Ferry Timetable Starts in May

headings.text: New Ferry Timetable Starts in May

key_sentences: From 4 May the harbour ferry will run every 30 minutes between the old quay and the island, seven days a week.
The council confirmed the new timetable after a successful trial last autumn.
Cyclists can now board without booking, and the larger vessel has room for twelve bicycles and four pushchairs.
Volunteers are needed for the spring clean-up of the slipway and the beach on Saturday 23 May.
The harbour master reminds all boat owners that the speed limit inside the harbour is five knots.
Children under five travel free, and concession fares apply to holders of a council discount card.

tables.caption: Upcoming events
rows: Fish market on the old quay

list_items.text: 1) Choose your date and time on the council website.
2) Select the number of passengers and bicycles.
3) Pay by card or buy a weekly pass.
4) Show the ticket on your phone when you board.
